messages:
Riley: Heads-up: Big pilot (ZetaHealth) just asked for tenant-scoped SSO + per-tenant encryption keys in MVP. Their contract depends on it. Our milestone is 2024-07-02. Can we realistically include both?
Noah: Short answer: per-tenant KMS + full admin UI is a separate effort (security review + infra) — estimate 4-6 dev-weeks total. SSO alone is doable if we cut scope.
Sam: Can we propose an MVP-light: ops-provisioned tenant keys (manual KMS binding) + config-file SSO like we did for ACME? That removes UI + self-serve pieces.
Priya: Legal/compliance flag: ZetaHealth needs an auditable key handling process. Manual ops setup is OK for pilot but must appear in SOW. We need explicit acceptance criteria.
Elena: Product concern: if we ship ops-provisioned keys, we must ensure secrets never leave HSM logs. Ops runbook required. Also need rollback plan if a key binding fails.
Jordan: Ops perspective: we can support manual KMS binding and an ops playbook. But we need a gating rule: only pilot tenants get this path until we automate. We'll require an opt-in feature flag and an ops ticket per tenant.
Riley: Ok — two trade choices: (A) push per-tenant KMS to v1 and only ship SSO (scoped) in MVP, or (B) include both with a heavy ops commitment. Preferences?
Noah: A is lower risk and keeps timeline. B will blow the milestone unless we pull engineers from other work.
Sam: A also lets us instrument and iterate. We can expose KMS automation in v1 once SSO + manual keys are validated.
Priya: From commercial: ZetaHealth prefers B but accepts A if we add a committed timeline to v1 and include interim mitigations in the SOW. They want an MRR credit if we miss v1 delivery.
Elena: If we go A, acceptance criteria for MVP SSO: staged login, tenant session isolation, and documented manual key-binding steps for pilot. No admin UI or SCIM.
Jordan: Operational gates: staging canary -> pilot tenant ops enable -> monitor 48h -> expand. Performance guard: auth path must not increase p50 by >4ms. Alert on assertion failures >0.5% over 10m window.
Riley: Sounds like consensus leaning A. Two customer asks to include in SOW: explicit delivery date for KMS automation (v1 target) and an interim support SLA for manual key ops.
Priya: I'll draft the SOW draft and tag Zeta.
Priya: I'll draft the SOW language. Suggest clause: "Pilot will receive ops-provisioned key binding and scoped SSO in MVP; automation targeted in v1 (ETA 2024-08-15). If automation not delivered by v1, Redwood will provide 3 months of complimentary manual key support."
Noah: Engineering ask: we need a strict cutlist. For MVP SSO slice we exclude: admin UI, SCIM, provisioning API, and tenant self-service KMS. Include: assertion handling, tenant mapping, basic metrics, and feature flag.
Sam: QA checklist quick: happy path login, assertion error variants, key binding failure modes, rollback to token auth per-tenant, telemetry sanity.
Elena: Security tasks: threat model review for ops key processes, short-lived test keys, rotate procedure documented.
Jordan: ops-bot: Canary slot booked: 2024-06-30 02:00 UTC (staging).
Riley: Action items: Priya SOW draft + commercial sign-off (owner), Noah cutlist + PR (owner), Elena security runbook (owner), Jordan ops rollout + canary (owner), Sam QA plan (owner). We'll reconvene 2 days after canary.
Priya: I'll post the SOW draft and tag Zeta.
Noah: I'll open the cutlist ticket and mark the MVP-light scope. ETA for infra work if prioritized: 8 business days.
Riley: Decision captured: Accept scoped MVP-light (SSO + manual KMS ops) with explicit gates and a v1 commitment for automation. Defer full self-serve KMS + admin UI to v1.
Elena: Noted risks: (1) manual ops scale if multiple pilots -> mitigations: strict pilot limit + SOW credits; (2) audit findings -> mitigation: pre-audit checklist and short-lived staging keys.
Sam: I'll convert QA checklist to test cases and link here.
Riley: Thanks everyone. Closing sync. :white_check_mark:
